name: Samael
source:
A young, troubled man who's about to be married because love is the most important thing to him. 
Samael yearns to be loved and it became his obsession. All he wants is a peacefull life together with his soulmate.
[From [url=https://chanimk.itch.io/forgive-my-desires-father]itch.io[/url]]

A troubled young man.
He's very timid.
He had a problematic childhood so his mindset can be questionable at times.
He's influenced easily.
[From [url=https://chanimk.itch.io/forgive-my-sins-father]itch.io[/url]]
